about_the_game:
The game Beltion: Beyond Ritual is an adventure action RPG based on the fantasy of Alexander Zorich. The author of books, well known to fans of videogames, as a script writer of computer blockbusters Men of War and The Tomorrow War.

The Vault of Equilibrium - a true inquisition intended to protect the country from forbidden magic. What is it like to be an investigator, prosecutor and executioner in one? It’s time to join the service and perform many dangerous tasks. You will have to cross the open sea and descend into the dungeon, fight against dark mages, strong fighters and entire armies. And then, at the top of your career, you will discover the mystery of the mighty Beltion!

  • Plot, script and game world by the cult fantasy author Alexander Zorich

  • Unique role system linked to career advancement

  • Special abilities of the hero: unusual vision regimes, communication with immaterial beings, prophetic visions

  • Advanced combat system - combination of blows, wide range of weapons and armor

  • The most picturesque corners and landscapes of the world Sarmontasara

  • Fascinating quests and unexpected plot twists

  • Big game world, living on its own rules
